user_query: I'm a car collector, and I want to add a Tesla to my collection. Can you provide me with the manufacturing location, year, and model of a Tesla using its VIN identifier 0f7885c2af1a6ef9?

Parse the retrieved information to extract the year and model of the Tesla.
